outreach_subject: A construction angle on your California insurance guide

replies.subject: Re: A construction angle on your California insurance guide
replies.body:
Hi Lisa,

Thanks for reaching out, but this is a bit outside the scope of our focus
on insurance.

Best,
Sarah Schlichter

On Sat, Aug 8, 2026 at 2:10 AM Lisa Monelli <info@myvilla.la> wrote:

> Hi Nerdwallet team,
>
> (Writing to the Nerdwallet newsroom rather than Sarah directly — we
> couldn't locate a direct contact. Feel free to forward if it's a
> better fit for them or the desk.)
>
> Your California homeowners insurance guide was genuinely clear, and
> the note on the January 2026 rules linking consumer protection to
> wildfire risk reduction is a connection most explainers leave
> implicit.
>
> A quick introduction: at My Villa, we bring European construction
> resilience and the Italian way of living to homes in Los Angeles,
> designed in exposed reinforced concrete, cemento a vista. In Europe,
> resilience has been default construction practice for generations.
>
> One thought your piece sparked: California is now writing into
> regulation what Mediterranean building has treated as ordinary for
> generations. That cultural lag feels like the interesting story behind
> the rate tables.
>
> Would you be interested in receiving more material on what we are
> doing, or in setting up a short call with our founder Paolo?
>
> Best,
> Lisa Monelli
> My Villa Media Team
> info@myvilla.la · myvilla.la
>


-- 
*Sarah Schlichter*
Senior Writer, Insurance
